mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_data.knowledge_space WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status <> 'DELETED'

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(document_count), 0) FROM ( SELECT source.knowledge_space_id, COUNT(*) AS document_count FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source source JOIN knowledge_data.knowledge_space space ON space.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND space.id = source.knowledge_space_id WHERE source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source.content_version > 0 AND space.status <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY source.knowledge_space_id ) counted

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(total_bytes), 0) FROM ( SELECT content.knowledge_space_id, SUM(content.byte_size::numeric) AS total_bytes FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source_content content JOIN knowledge_data.knowledge_space space ON space.tenant_id = content.tenant_id AND space.id = content.knowledge_space_id WHERE content.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND space.status <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY content.knowledge_space_id ) counted

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_data.governed_data_source source JOIN knowledge_data.knowledge_space space ON space.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND space.id = source.knowledge_space_id WHERE source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND space.status <> 'DELETED'
